run_separate_tracks: run demucs to separate audio tracks into individual stems like vocals, drums, bass, and other
run_list_models: run demucs to list all available pretrained bag and single models from the current repo
run_two_stems_separation: run demucs to separate a track into only two stems such as vocals and no_vocals
run_separate_with_mp3_output: run demucs to separate audio tracks and save output as mp3 files with a custom bitrate
run_separate_with_custom_segment: run demucs to separate audio using a custom segment size to reduce GPU memory usage
